scenes.title: Say no to **extra work**
scenes.prompt: A client asked for [extra request] that isn't in our scope: [paste scope]. Write a polite reply that explains it's outside the current scope, offers to quote it separately at $[price], and keeps the relationship warm.
scenes.tip: you protect your time without sounding rigid.

caption:
